messageCenterItems.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Unified RBAC support for App Governance to manage NHIs
messageCenterItems.summary: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will support unified Defender XDR RBAC in public preview starting late November 2026, enabling delegated, least-privilege access for managing Non-Human Identities. Administrators can assign custom roles for viewing, policy, and service management, with rollout completing by mid-January 2027.
messageCenterItems.body:
What and Why:

App Governance in Defender for Cloud Apps will now support Microsoft Defender XDR unified role-based access control (RBAC) in public preview.

This capability lets your organization delegate access to App Governance through Defender XDR custom roles, for supported App Governance capabilities. You can align access with administrators' responsibilities and apply least-privilege permissions when managing Non-Human Identities, including Microsoft Entra applications.

Rollout Schedule:

Public Preview (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by mid-December 2026.

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in mid-December 2026 and expect to complete by mid-January 2027.

Impact on Your Organization:

Administrators will be able to configure and assign Defender XDR unified RBAC custom roles to users or groups for the following capabilities:

  1. Read access: View App Governance inventory, insights, risk signals, and policies.
  2. Policy management: Create and edit App Governance policies.
  3. Service management: Turn the App Governance service on or off.

Users with existing Defender for Cloud Apps unified RBAC roles may also gain App Governance access, depending on their assigned permissions and data sources. Review these assignments to ensure access remains appropriate.

Supported Microsoft Entra roles will continue to provide App Governance access, subject to documented role changes. Microsoft Entra application enable and disable actions continue to require the Application Administrator role; this preview does not replace that requirement.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Review existing Defender XDR unified RBAC assignments, particularly roles used for Defender for Cloud Apps.

To delegate App Governance access, create or update a custom role in the Microsoft Defender portal under Setup & Configuration > Permissions > Microsoft Defender XDR > Roles. Configure the permissions appropriate to each administrator's responsibilities. Select the applicable data sources as described in the updated configuration guidance.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
